what: Whether CGGA's terms allow republishing its patient identifiers (deposit checklist item 3.2). The committed manifest data/partitions/cgga_external_v1.json lists 218 CGGA sample ids and no clinical or expression value.

sources_read.https://www.cgga.org.cn/download.jsp: No terms of use or licence stated. Files are downloadable without registration. Each dataset carries a citation request ('If you use this part of the data ..., please consider to cite').
sources_read.Zhao Z, et al. Chinese Glioma Genome Atl: States 'we have decided to make CGGA publicly available for worldwide researchers'; IRB approval of Beijing Tiantan Hospital; written informed consent from all patients; 'All data referred to in this article can be found online at http://www.cgga.org.cn'.

finding: No prohibition on republishing identifiers was found. The ids are CGGA's own pseudonymous sample codes, already published in CGGA's public clinical files. The manifest holds ids only.
residual: CGGA states no explicit licence. If a journal or committee asks for written permission, ask CGGA (contact page of cgga.org.cn).
obligation: Cite Zhao et al. 2021 (above) wherever CGGA data or the manifest are used.
